FN-UN83DXX-1
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 136
Committee: Fiscal Responsibility and Economic Development Sponsor: Senator Garlan Gudger
Analyst: Mathieu Fuller Date: 02/21/2024
Senate Bill 136 as introduced provides for the continuance of the Statewide 911 Board until
October 1, 2026 pursuant to the Alabama Sunset Law. This bill will not otherwise affect state or
local funding.
